 Order
This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

2. The applicant is in custody since 07.11.2024 in connection with Crime No.252/2024 registered at P.S.-Badi, District-Raisen (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(F), 376(2)(n) and 506 of IPC.
3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that applicant repeatedly established physical relation with prosecutrix from 31.01.2022 to 19.08.2024 without her consent.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that incident is said to have occurred from 31.01.2022 to 19.08.2024.
FIR has been lodged on 04.11.2024.
There is delay in lodging FIR for which no explanation has been furnished.
No injury has been found on the person of prosecutrix.
It is urged that on account of family dispute, applicant has been falsely implicated.
No mobile phone has been seized.
There is no DNA report on record.
No purpose would be served by keeping the applicant behind the bar.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:60497 2 MCRC-51696-2024 trial.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail 6.
Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, first bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant-Gopal Prasad Kushwaha be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE L.R.
